errors.text: The proposed recovery mechanism emphasizes smoothing of B2/FCC interfaces, whereas the target mechanism specifically involves reduced L12 ordering and formation of ductile transition zones along phase boundaries.

The claim that enhanced ordering produces low SFE is not established by the cited evidence; the NiCoCr simulation cited reports increasing complex stacking-fault energy with stronger local chemical order.
The critical chemical-ordering boundary is left qualitative rather than being tied explicitly to FCC domains approaching near-stoichiometric Ni3Al-type L12 order.
The numerical APBE and elongation thresholds, as well as the 100–500 hour aging duration, are unsupported by the supplied evidence.
